whatIs: Stick It Up is a sticker library for interfaces: hand-drawn SVG illustrations in pastel tones that scale to any size and already include interactions such as dragging, tilting and a hover effect. You install it with npm (stick-it-up) and it's open source under the MIT license.
It's a good fit when you want to add personality to a landing page, a card, an empty state or a 404 page without commissioning illustrations.
uses: Decorating a landing page's hero with stickers that react to the mouse.
Adding a friendly touch to an empty state or a 404 page.
Adding playful details to cards or sections of a portfolio.
caveats: It's designed for React and Next.js, so it doesn't work as-is in other frameworks.
It's a set of illustrations with a very distinct style; check that it fits your design.
The interactions use the mouse, so on touch screens the effect isn't the same.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license; the only charge on the site is brand sponsorship.
idealFor: React or Next.js projects looking for fun, interactive illustrations.
